steps.en: Install the adapter for your framework
steps.zh: 安装对应框架的适配包

steps.en: Create a virtualizer: item count, the scroll element, a size estimate
steps.zh: 创建虚拟器：条目数、滚动元素、行高估计

steps.en: Give it a fixed-height scroll box and an inner sizer as tall as the whole list
steps.zh: 准备固定高度的滚动框，里面放一个和整个列表一样高的撑高层

steps.en: Watches scroll position and box size; computes which rows are visible plus overscan, and their offsets
steps.zh: 监听滚动位置和容器尺寸，算出可见行（加缓冲行）和各自偏移

steps.en: Render only those rows, absolutely positioned, with its measuring ref
steps.zh: 只渲染这些行，绝对定位，并挂上它的测量 ref

steps.en: Measures real row heights, fixes positions and keeps the viewed content from jumping
steps.zh: 测出真实行高，修正位置，让正在看的内容不跳动

value.en: A 10,000-row list mounts and scrolls like a 30-row one, and you never hand-write the offset math or give up your own row markup
value.zh: 一万行的列表挂载和滚动起来和三十行一样轻，不用手算偏移，也不用放弃自己的行标签
